notes: Inbound trial - signed up via self-serve on 2026-02-10. First API keys provisioned. Low usage so far (~12k tokens).
Use-case: customer support assistant + internal doc search; prioritizes low latency for snippets and high relevance for long-form answers.
CTO (Daniel Park) asked: 'Are Llama 2 / Mistral / Qwen variants comparable for our ticket summarization workload? What's the quality vs cost tradeoff at 7B/13B?'
Wants guidance on model family and size: recommended options, expected quality delta (ROUGE/F1) for summarization, and per-token cost estimates for hosted API.
Latency target: p95 < 500ms for short replies (<128 tokens). Throughput target: ~30 concurrent users, avg 4 reqs/min/user. Cost sensitivity: SMB budget, target <$0.015 per 1k tokens.
Security: SOC2 required; needs SSO/SAML (Okta) and audit logs. Data retention policy: 90 days. No strict residency requirement but prefer US/EU availability.

SE notes: suggest Mistral-7B-Instruct for cost-sensitive high quality; Llama-2-13B for higher quality / higher cost; Qwen-7B as a middle-ground. Recommend A/B test via hosted API with routing + fallback to smaller model on load.
Questions from customer: which quantized variants are supported on hosted API? any impact on hallucination rates? recommended max response length and chunking strategy for doc-search embeddings?

Next: run quickbench on customer's sample prompts (latency, token cost) across Mistral-7B, Llama-2-13B, Qwen-7B; deliver comparison matrix and a 2-model rollout plan with expected monthly spend scenarios.
Blockers: budget not finalized, pending SOC2 legal review, confirm SSO provider and retention SLA.
